summary: Real-time public conversation, now tightly coupled to its own in-house AI.
moat: X's moat is the real-time firehose of public reaction during breaking events — a live social graph and attention layer that static models cannot reproduce. Its exposure is that the same platform routes users to Grok for synthesized answers, and rival real-time networks are competing for the culture-defining conversation that gives X its relevance.

challengers.name: Bluesky
challengers.evidence: Bluesky surpassed 30 million users in 2025, drawing away communities seeking a real-time public timeline.
